facts.title: Check automatic and explicit collection
facts.description: PostHog documents separate controls for autocapture, identified events and capture opt-in or opt-out. Confirm the enabled products, SDK settings and consent integration before describing the data collected.

facts.title: Replay needs its own review
facts.description: Replay has input masking, content controls and optional network capture. Test the actual pages and payloads, including headers and bodies; masking form fields does not describe every recording setting.

facts.title: Filtering after receipt is a different boundary
facts.description: PostHog distinguishes collection controls from transformations and IP-discard settings on its servers. Data that must never reach the provider needs to be excluded before transmission.

facts.title: A public DPA page is not your signed copy
facts.description: PostHog identifies its public DPA as a preview and directs customers to generate and countersign the agreement in their organization. Retain the agreement actually used.

facts.title: Review the installed SDK and integrations
facts.description: Sentry documents collection that varies by runtime and integrations, including URLs, request data, identifiers and source maps. Check the installed SDK version, explicit user data and collection options; a monitoring label does not describe its payloads.

facts.title: Replay controls are separate
facts.description: Sentry documents replay masking, blocking, console and network capture controls separately from general SDK data-collection options. Test configured pages and enabled network details before enabling recording.

facts.title: Submitted events use the customer agreement
facts.description: Sentry distinguishes submitted Service Data from the information covered by its own privacy policy. Review the customer agreement and DPA for events sent from this application.
